features.name: Shared DLL Contracts
features.description: Client and server share enums/types through GameCommon.dll.

features.name: Google Protobuf Registry and Diagnostics
features.description: Generated protobuf packets are bound and validated by ProtocolRegistry and ProtoDiagnostics.

features.name: Authoritative JSON World Config
features.description: World generation, map control, and runtime parameters are loaded from JSON and mirrored.

features.name: Hydrology Signature v65 + Profile v69
features.description: Server/client/probe enforce hydrology signature and minimum map-control profile version.

features.name: World Map Queue and Runtime Control
features.description: Chunk queue pressure, emergency brake, and policy controls are managed in data-driven runtime flow.

features.name: Session and Network Lifecycle
features.description: SessionManager and protocol handlers orchestrate login, keepalive, request dispatch, and disconnect flow.

features.name: Deterministic Base Terrain and Biomes
features.description: Terrain height, biome bands, and erosion-aware masks are generated deterministically from seed and config.

features.name: Improved River Generator
features.description: Hydrology-flow coupled river generation with confluence, delta, avulsion, and edge continuity bridges.

features.name: Improved Lake Generator
features.description: Lake basin, spillway, riparian retention, groundwater latch, and floodplain exchange are stabilized.

features.name: Improved Cave Generator
features.description: Cave generation applies hydrology, flow, aquifer suppression, and ceiling stability seals for safer subterranean topology.

features.name: Session 141 River Backwater Anchor
features.description: Adds floodplain backwater anchoring to reduce downstream discontinuities near low-relief channels.

features.name: Session 141 Lake Lagoon Exchange
features.description: Adds backwater-lagoon exchange coupling to improve lake-river continuity and floodplain retention.

features.name: Session 141 Cave Lagoon-Karst Ceiling Seal
features.description: Adds lagoon/karst-influenced roof sealing to suppress unstable flooded cave ceilings.

features.name: World Map Control Client Preview Parity
features.description: Unity world-map preview uses shared profile fields and map-control verification to keep terrain previews server-aligned.

features.name: Data-Driven Blocks, Items, and Biomes
features.description: In-game content catalogs are loaded from JSON for blocks, items, and biome/gameplay parameters.

features.name: Config Parity Manifest Automation
features.description: Canonical config parity manifest mirrors JSON configs between server and client streaming assets.

features.name: Server Dummy Protocol Probe
features.description: DummyProtocolClient validates packet encode/decode round-trips, descriptor coverage, and version/signature guards.

features.name: Standalone Dummy Minecraft Client
features.description: Standalone dummy client executable exists for packet flow smoke tests between client and server.

features.name: Generated Protobuf Source Audit
features.description: Server startup verifies generated protobuf source files and descriptor health.

features.name: Using and Reference Compile Verification
features.description: Cross-project compile checks validate using directives and type references.

features.name: Session Planning and Documentation
features.description: Work plan and implementation reports are continuously updated in plans/docs markdown.
